title: refactor(rest): move registerCrudEndpoints into crud-routes.ts (#23050 slice 12)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 12 of the `rest-server.ts` split: **CRUD**. It follows slice 1's pattern and slices 2–11's shape, with slice 11 (PR #24054) as the direct precedent. The body of `RestServer#registerCrudEndpoints` moves, re-indented one level and otherwise unedited, to one new module, `packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts`. That body is the six record doors under `{basePath}{crud.dataPrefix}`: list, read, create, the QueryAST query, update and delete.

Nothing else moves:
- the route table, the ordered registrations and every handler's source (whitespace-free digest) are byte-identical;
- the published `dist/*.d.ts` is byte-identical, and so are both bundles' export lists;
- no token of the body changed.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 9,512 to 9,086 lines (base `cb8756b00`). #23050 stays open for the last slice, `/meta` (`registerMetadataEndpointsInner`), which this PR does not touch.

`packages/spec/liveness/crud_endpoints.json` gets six evidence-path substitutions. The consumer text, quoted code, producers, verdicts and statuses are unchanged. This is the one `packages/spec` exception declared to the spec seat on #6017 as `6235976157`, under slice 11's precedent (ruling A `6225503839`).

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads.** Measured by an AST walk of the method (TypeScript compiler API, base `cb8756b00`). The method spans `:8323`–`:8759`, and the body inside it spans `:8324`–`:8758` (435 lines).

| kind | member | reads | class declaration |
|---|---|---|---|
| field | `config` | 1 (`:8324`, the body's first statement) | `:1997`, private |
| field | `routeManager` | 6, the six `register` calls | `:1998`, private |
| method | `resolveProtocol` | 6 | `:2376`, private async |
| method | `resolveExecCtx` | 6 | `:2863`, private async |
| method | `enforceAuth` | 6 | `:2444`, private |
| method | `enforceApiAccess` | 6 | `:2631`, private async |

The body has no bare `this`, no element access on `this`, no `RestServer.` static access and no `function` keyword.

**Control walk** (the same walker on the same base): the `registerUiEndpoints` stub reads `routeManager`, `resolveRequestEnvironmentId`, `resolveExecCtx`, `enforceAuth`, `enforceEnvironmentOwnership` and `resolveProtocol` once each. That is slice 10's host literal, member for member.

**Module-level names the body reads** (the same walk):
- **Read only by this body, so the import moves with it.** A pointer comment is left in `rest-server.ts`' import block for each:
  - the five data request types `FindDataRequest`, `GetDataRequest`, `CreateDataRequest`, `UpdateDataRequest` and `DeleteDataRequest`, with their #15866 note;
  - `assertFilterParamSuppliedOnce`, with its #7390 note;
  - `logUnexpectedRouteError` and `applyDroppedFieldsHeader`.
- **Still read elsewhere, so the import stays.** The module imports the same names from the same modules: `mapDataError`, `refuseUnknownQueryParams`, `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`, `zodIssuesToFields` and `validationFailure`.
- **`ServerScopedDataRequest`** is imported from `data-action-routes.ts`, where slice 1 moved it. Its last reader in `rest-server.ts` was this body, so `rest-server.ts` no longer imports it. The slice-1 note there now says so.
- **Two names are declared in `rest-server.ts` itself, stay there and are imported from it:**
  - `DATA_RECORD_READ_PARAMS`. It was already exported, and its pin test (`rest-server-closed-query-params.test.ts`) imports it from there. This is slice 3's shape for `APPROVAL_REQUEST_LIST_PARAMS`.
  - `versionTokenRefusal`. It gains `export` for this module only, the shape slices 1 and 2 used for their helpers. It does not move, because the runtime dispatcher's `/data` twin (`packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts:79`) names `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` as the home of its full argument, and `packages/runtime/**` is outside this slice. Moving it would make that pointer false.
  - The package entry re-exports neither name, and the `.d.ts` is byte-identical (below). Both are read only at request time, so the two modules importing each other cannot see them uninitialised.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B).** `CrudRouteHost` has 6 members, in the order the body first reads them, each typed `RestServer['m']`.
- The class keeps the private method's name, docblock and position. Its JSDoc plus signature (base `:8320`–`:8323`, head `:8316`–`:8319`) diffs to 0.
- Its body is the host literal plus `registerCrudEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`.
- The call site in `registerRoutes`' `registerForBase` is unchanged: `if (this.config.api.enableCrud) { this.registerCrudEndpoints(bp); }`, after `registerDataActionEndpoints`. `registerRoutes` (75 lines) diffs to 0 between base and head.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | registration only: `const { crud } = this.config;` is the body's first statement, and the handlers close over `crud`, `operations`, `dataPath` and `isScoped` | no, assigned only in the constructor (`:2138` at head) | value |
| `routeManager` | registration only (the six `register` calls) | its one swap (`:5166`/`:5170` at head) wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |

No provider field is read. The protocol, the caller's context, the anonymous-deny gate and the per-object API exposure gate are each resolved per request by a METHOD, so no getter is owed.

**Route switches.** The registrar has its own switches: `api.enableCrud`, the five `crud.operations` (`list` gates two mounts) and `crud.dataPrefix`. So slice 10/11's nine configurations are extended with four CRUD ones (below).

**Late binding, measured.** A one-off vitest file was copied in, run under the verify lock and deleted; it is not committed.
- **Setup.** A source `RestServer` gets the four methods planted BEFORE `registerRoutes()`, and all six doors are driven. Then four new methods are planted AFTER registration, and the six doors are driven again.
- **Head:** `MEASURE before: GET 200 {"records":[{"id":"early"}]} | GET 200 {"id":"early"} | POST 201 {"id":"early"} | POST 200 {"records":[{"id":"early"}]} | PATCH 200 {"id":"early"} | DELETE 200 {"id":"early","success":true}`. After the re-plant, every door answers `"late"`. The order is `late:proto,late:ctx,late:auth,late:api` ×6, with `early calls after re-plant 0`. `Tests 1 passed (1)`.
- **Ablation:** the host literal's `enforceApiAccess` closure was replaced by `this.enforceApiAccess.bind(this)` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `bc2c21614369` → `d8d11e7ef378`). `early:api` then runs on all six doors after the re-plant: `AssertionError: expected [ 'early:api', 'early:api', …(4) ] to deeply equal []`, `Tests 1 failed (1)`. The tool restored the file: blob `bc2c21614369` equals `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Base leg:** the base `rest-server.ts` (blob `5a0f948c2e8a`) was put in the tree under a trap. It printed the same two `MEASURE` lines byte for byte, `Tests 1 passed (1)`. Restored: blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Proof of move-only

- **Moved body.** Base `rest-server.ts` lines 8324–8758, with one 4-space indent removed, against `crud-routes.ts` lines 107–541: `diff` exits 0 over all 435 lines, so no token changed.
  - Every non-empty line of the range carries the method indent.
  - No line has trailing whitespace.
  - No line has an odd backtick count, so no template literal spans the cut.
- **`.d.ts`.** `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` were built at base `cb8756b00` before any edit and at `45d976972`. Both legs are sha256 `1f0f455d24836d47de60716233f1bd74d1738c04046974019264b17b5261bbe8`, and `cmp` exits 0 on each pair.
  - The head bundles carry a head-only marker: `registerCrudEndpoints.call` hits 1 in each of `index.js` and `index.cjs`, and 0 at base. So the declaration was rebuilt from the moved source.
  - Exporting `versionTokenRefusal` from `rest-server.ts` moved no declaration. That matches slice 1's measurement: exporting a function or a constant does not change the bundle's `.d.ts`.
- **Export lists.** The base and head ESM and CJS bundles each load with 39 exports and one sorted export-name list (sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…` on all four).
- **Routes (`RestServer.getRoutes()`).** A source `RestServer` was booted on a recording mock server, with a protocol answering every member. Each dump holds:
  - `getRoutes()` (functions as arity);
  - the ordered server registration calls;
  - a whitespace-free sha256 of every handler's source, plus that source.

  It was dumped under thirteen configs:
  - slice 10/11's nine: default; scoped-optional; scoped-required; every provider set; `enableDiscovery: false`; `enableOpenApi: false`; both off under scoped-optional; `enableSearch: false` under scoped-optional; `enableUi: false` under scoped-optional;
  - this slice's four, for the registrar's own switches: `enableCrud: false` under scoped-optional; `crud.operations` `{ list: false, delete: false }` under scoped-optional; all five operations false; `crud.dataPrefix: '/objects'` under scoped-optional.

  Results:
  - Route counts are 75 / 150 / 75 / 75 / 73 / 73 / 142 / 148 / 148 / 138 / 144 / 69 / 150, with 6 / 12 / 6 / 6 / 6 / 6 / 12 / 12 / 12 / 0 / 6 / 0 / 12 CRUD-tagged routes. The first nine are slice 11's figures.
  - `routes.json`, `calls.json` and `handlers.json` are byte-identical between base and head in all thirteen configs. The sha256 over the 39 dump files is `8e9544b5b00f03081398465aa73416f51aee7a4aeef956ed550283937017daa8` on both legs, and the default config's `routes.json` is `6931d1a5d1827fea…` on both.
  - A second base run was identical to the first (`diff -r` exit 0). Every handler digest is identical, because no token changed.
- **The handler digest can fail.** A positive control added one character to the moved PATCH handler through `ablation-replace.mjs`: `'Invalid update request'` became `'Invalid update request!'` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `d25749c75351` → `251ede3ffa43`).
  - Routes and calls were unchanged in all thirteen configs.
  - The handler digests moved in exactly the `PATCH …/:object/:id` door of each mounted base, and nowhere else. That is 1 or 2 per config, and none in the two configs where that door is not mounted.
  - Restored: blob `d25749c75351` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **The route ledger the gates read** (`packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`) is not edited. Its conformance tests against `getRoutes()` pass in the `local` run below.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

`packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts` gains `crud-routes.ts`, with a `[#23050 slice 12]` comment (length 12 → 13). Every reader that pins its length re-reads its number:

| reader | sum over the list | change |
|---|---|---|
| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 16 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 6; mentions 125 → 129 | The six CRUD sites (bare, each guarded on its next line) moved. The four new mentions are the seam: the forwarder, two, and the host interface's member, two. `rest-server.ts` goes 60 → 56. Thirteen forwarders = (13 − 1) + 3 − 2. Length 12 → 13 |
| `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` | 8 = 6 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 2 + 0 ×7 | The CRUD doors read no draft. Length 12 → 13 |
| `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts` | 9 = 8 + 1 + 0 ×11 | The CRUD doors coerce no number. Length 12 → 13 |
| `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` (`repo` project) | 4 = 0 + 3 + 0 ×10 + 1 `query:` slots | The list door's caller-supplied `query: req.query` moved, so the floors are `rest-server.ts` 1 → 0 and `crud-routes.ts: 1`. Length 12 → 13 |
| `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` | floors 4 + 3 + 3 + 8 + 3 + 8 + 5 + 3 + 3 + 4 + 3 + 3 = 50 | The floor is `crud-routes.ts: 3`: the module header, the host interface's block and the function's. The CRUD body held no TSDoc block, so `rest-server.ts` keeps its 163. Length 12 → 13 |
| `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` | `this.enforceAuth(` 59 → 60, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 74 → 75 | +1 each for the host literal's forwarder; the six call sites are counted in both readings. Length 12 → 13 |
| `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts` | as above; the ownership guard is still 1 call site + 1 forwarder | Length 12 → 13 |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` (realtime tripwires) | 0 hits over the thirteen files | Length 12 → 13 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, `rest-server.ts` row | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged; `this.routeManager.register(` 63 = 12 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 6; `private register*Endpoints(` 16; `enforceAuth` 108 → 112 | New control `crud-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 6; `registrar list length` 13; `populationRule` names the new module. `enforceAuth` is RE-ANCHORED, not relaxed: the six call sites moved and are counted in both readings, and the four new occurrences are the seam |

Readers outside the list:

- **`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`** (a gate's target table, `domain:spec`).
  - `crud-routes.ts` is declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, as the eleven earlier modules are. Its measured counts are `stringError 3` and `siblingCode 3`: the three request gates' 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` bodies (`'Invalid create request'`, `'Invalid query request'`, `'Invalid update request'`).
  - `rest-server.ts` drops by exactly those bodies: `stringError` 11 → 8 and `siblingCode` 7 → 4, each recorded as "NOT progress — the same MOVE".
  - The sums are unchanged: 8 + 13 + 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 1 + 0 + 1 + 4 + 3 = 39, and 4 + 15 + 8 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 3 + 0 + 1 + 6 + 3 = 54.
  - Its output differs from base only in the `rest-server.ts` row and the new row (22 → 23 modules audited, 13 → 14 ratcheted).
- **`packages/spec/liveness/crud_endpoints.json`.** Six evidence paths `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts#registerCrudEndpoints` → `packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts#registerCrudEndpoints`: the five `operations.*` rows (`if (operations.X)`) and the first citation of the `dataPrefix` row (`const dataPath = …crud.dataPrefix…`). Every quoted fragment now lives in `crud-routes.ts`. See the next section.
- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`** (`domain:devx`, slice 7/11's precedent). Three sources name `crud-routes.ts`; the text after each anchor is unchanged, and no history entry is added:
  - `api-backend.query-contract-matrix`: `rest-server.ts (POST /data/:object/query answers a FindDataRequestSchema failure …)` → `crud-routes.ts (…)`.
  - `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix`: `rest-server.ts#data (POST /data/:object/query …)` → `crud-routes.ts#data (…)`.
  - `api-backend.rest-crud-config-contract`: `rest-server.ts#registerCrudEndpoints (the six mounts and their five gates), (normalizeConfig …), (parseDeclaredSubConfig …), (getRoutes …)` → `crud-routes.ts#registerCrudEndpoints (the six mounts and their five gates) + packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts (normalizeConfig …), (parseDeclaredSubConfig …), (getRoutes …)`. The three helpers did not move, and slice 7 split the same source with `+` in the same way.
  - `check:platform-checklist`: 853 of 863 anchors resolve on both trees; cited sources go 400 → 401.
- **No ADR anchor.** The CRUD body cites no ADR. `check-adr-anchors` reads 70 anchored files and 1,782 decision-letter citations at base, at the move commit and at the head. `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__rest-server.ts.json` anchors ADR-0045's `filterAppForUser`, which did not move.
- **No `content/docs/**` anchor.** Measured: no page under `content/docs` (references and releases excluded) cites the CRUD code by path, symbol or line.

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the readers at their base text:

- **At the move commit `c8f1643c8`** (the list not yet grown):
  - `local` read `Test Files 1 failed | 290 passed (291)`, `Tests 3 failed | 6004 passed | 326 skipped (6333)`. The failures are the execctx census: `expected 56 to be 62`, then `expected 40 to be 46` twice. The six CRUD sites had left the reach of a reader that did not yet know the module.
  - `repo` read `Tests 2 failed | 252 passed | 12 skipped (266)`. These are the canonical-query-AST floor (`expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 1`) and its slot sum (`expected 3 to be 4`).
  - `check:route-envelope` read `crud-routes.ts NOT DECLARED`, `stringError: found 8, declared 11` and `siblingCode: found 4, declared 7`.
- **At `3e58c49cb`** (the list grown, the readers not yet re-pointed):
  - `local` (the six list readers) read `Test Files 6 failed (6)`, `Tests 7 failed | 115 passed (122)`. These are the six length pins (`expected [ 'rest-server.ts', …(12) ] to have a length of 12 but got 13`) and the docblock pin's unfloored new module.
  - `repo` read `Tests 3 failed | 76 passed | 13 skipped (92)`: the length pin and both floors.
  - The dogfood pair read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)`: the tripwire's length pin, and `control "registrar list length" moved in packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts: expected 13 to be 12`.
- **Each is green after the re-point** (`45d976972`, then the merge head).

## The `packages/spec` reader, re-pointed (the declared exception)

`crud_endpoints.json` cited `rest-server.ts#registerCrudEndpoints` for the code that gates and prefixes the CRUD mounts, and that code now lives in `crud-routes.ts`. `check:liveness` stays green either way:
- the stub keeps the symbol `registerCrudEndpoints` in `rest-server.ts`;
- `rest-server.ts` still names every key (`operations`, `dataPrefix`) in `normalizeConfig`.

So without the substitution the six rows would have read as anchored while pointing at a file that no longer holds the quoted code. That is the dead-pin shape the card warns about, and no gate would have caught it. The substitution keeps them pointing at the consumer.

`check:liveness` at the head exits 0. It reads `symbol anchors: 945 pointer(s) written path#symbol, 945 naming a symbol the cited file contains.` and `key-mention anchoring: 735 (entry, cited file) pair(s) asked, 734 anchored, 1 exempt.` (734 / 733 / 1 at base). The `dataPrefix` row now cites two files, `crud-routes.ts` for the CRUD mount and `rest-server.ts` for its four sibling consumers, so it asks one more pair, and that pair anchors.

No `rest_api.json` row cites the moved code. That was measured over every liveness file by extracting each backtick-quoted fragment from the rows that cite `rest-server.ts`. Only the six `crud_endpoints.json` rows quote code found in the CRUD body and nowhere else in `rest-server.ts`. `rest_api.json`'s `enableCrud` row cites `registerRoutes`' `if (this.config.api.enableCrud)`, which did not move.

Changesets:
- `.changeset/23050-s12-crud-liveness-citations.md` is a `@objectstack/spec` patch (`Clause-②: no`), because `liveness/` ships in that package's `files[]`.
- `.changeset/23050-s12-crud-routes-move.md` is a `@objectstack/rest` patch (`Clause-②: no`, move-only), because the shipped `dist/index.js` and `index.cjs` bytes change: the head-only marker above. The declarations and exports do not change.
- `skip-changeset` does not apply.

## Readers examined and not re-pointed

- **Prose that names the registrar without a file or line, and is still true:**
  - `registerRoutes`' comment ("the greedy GET /data/:object/:id matcher in registerCrudEndpoints");
  - `DATA_RECORD_READ_PARAMS`' docblock ("Measured, at `registerCrudEndpoints`' read-record handler");
  - `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` (`byRegistrar.get('registerCrudEndpoints')`, read off the mounted registrar at runtime);
  - the dogfood census `note`;
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` E3;
  - `packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts` and the `18.api__CrudEndpointsConfig__patterns` retired-key entry ("the server's `registerCrudEndpoints`");
  - the generated `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx`.
- **`crud_endpoints.json`'s `patterns` note** says "every CRUD route is mounted from the fixed method/path pairs in rest-server.ts#registerCrudEndpoints". It is a dead row's retirement record, dated 2026-09-03, and it still resolves by name to the stub. It was left as written, together with the `dataPrefix` row's four sibling citations (`#registerDataActionEndpoints`, `#registerSharingEndpoints`, `#registerBatchEndpoints`, `#registerDiscoveryEndpoints`), which cite bodies earlier slices moved. That is outside this slice's declared substitution (see Acceptance notes).
- **`docs/adr/0036-…`** cites `@objectstack/rest` `registerCrudEndpoints()`. It is Tier H and not edited, and the name still resolves.
- **The runtime `/data` twin's pointer** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts:79`, "`versionTokenRefusal` in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`") stays true, because the function stays there.
- **Repo tests outside `packages/rest` that read `packages/rest/src`:**
  - `core`'s `authz-store-unavailable.test.ts` classifies `rest-server.ts` as `guarded` for a seam the CRUD body never calls;
  - `runtime`'s `meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` reads only the `GET {metaPath}/:type` handler;
  - `spec`'s five list `packages/rest` test FILES by name.

  None reads the moved code, and all three `test:repo` runs are green below.
- **Gates that walk `packages/rest/src` reach the moved code in its new file.** Their scan outputs were compared between a worktree at `origin/main` `2bcaefba9` and the final head `c333dafda`. They differ only by the one scanned file or by this diff's own re-points:
  - `check-meta-type-normalized` 40 → 41 files;
  - `check-undeclared-dep-imports` +1 file, +2 specifiers;
  - `check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary` and `check-error-status-conformance` +1 file, classified sites unchanged;
  - `check-affected-docs` route sources 30 → 31 and registration call sites 25 → 26, by the `*-routes.ts` convention;
  - `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` 3910 → 3914 file-level anchors (the route-envelope gate's new comments);
  - `check:platform-checklist` cited sources 400 → 401;
  - `check:liveness` one more key-mention pair, anchored;
  - `check-route-envelope` the two rows above.

  These are identical: `check-system-context-census`, `check-single-authz-resolver`, `check-rest-log-declared`, `check-durability-degradation-log-level`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-adr-anchors` (70 anchored files, 1,782 decision-letter citations). At the move commit, against base `cb8756b00`, the four walkers already read the one extra file, before any re-point.

## Acceptance notes

- **`versionTokenRefusal`'s docblock** still says "this file THROWS it into the route's catch". The throw now sits in `crud-routes.ts`, in the same `RestServer` doors. This is a prose pointer, not edited by a move (no carrier).
- **The `dataPrefix` row's four sibling citations and the `patterns` note** cite `rest-server.ts#register…` names whose bodies slices 1, 2, 4, 7 and this one moved. Each still resolves by name to its stub, and `check:liveness` anchors them by file. Re-pointing them is outside this slice's declared `packages/spec` substitution. Carrier: the `domain:spec` seat, through the seat's #6017 declaration; nothing filed.
- **`check:liveness`' key-mention axis is file-level.** A row that cites a stub's name in a file that still names the key elsewhere reads as anchored after its quoted code moves. This slice re-points by hand. No new gate: card rule 5.
- **Carried from earlier slices, untouched:** `ui-routes.ts`' "52 sites" comment and `email-routes.ts`' double-mount header (no non-move edit of either text here).

## Gates and tests

**Final head `c333dafda`.** It is one merge of `origin/main` `2bcaefba9` (#24170, #24177, #24180, #24178, #24181). None of those touches a file in this diff. `rest-server.ts`' blob is `5a0f948c2e8a` at `cb8756b00` and at `2bcaefba9`. main's #24178 changed `data-action-routes.ts`' export handler, so the merge-head proofs are taken against `origin/main` itself:
- **`.d.ts`.** A base leg put `origin/main`'s `rest-server.ts` into the merged tree under a trap and built `@objectstack/rest`. It gives `1f0f455d…` with the marker at 0. Restored (blob and `git diff HEAD` proof) and rebuilt, the head gives `1f0f455d…` with the marker at 1. The export lists are 39 / `b3246be6…` on both bundles.
- **Routes.** The thirteen-config dumps with `origin/main`'s `rest-server.ts` equal the merge head's (`diff -r` exit 0, sha256 `1d7630283baf…` on both legs). They differ from `cb8756b00`'s only in the `GET …/data/:object/export` handler digest, which is #24178.

Commits:
- `c8f1643c8`, the move;
- `3e58c49cb`, the list;
- `45d976972`, the re-points;

All builds and suites ran through `os-verify-lock`, and every exit was written to a file before any pipe. At `c333dafda`:

- **Build.** `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/rest...' --filter '@objectstack/verify...' --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` exit 0. Then `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2` (whole workspace) exit 0: `Tasks: 77 successful, 77 total`.
- **Generated artifacts.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0: `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`. main moved `packages/spec`.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` exit 0: `check:test-typecheck: OK … 0 file(s) / 0 error(s)`.
- **`@objectstack/rest`.** `local`: `Test Files 292 passed (292)`, `Tests 6015 passed | 326 skipped (6341)`. `repo`, which is its `test:repo`: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 258 passed | 13 skipped (271)`.
